tasks.title: Fix off-by-one in date range picker
tasks.body: Selecting a date range excludes the final day. The end date should be inclusive.

tasks.title: Date filter drops the last selected day
tasks.body: When users pick a start and end date, results for the end date are missing. Make the range inclusive of the end.

tasks.title: Migrate CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
tasks.body: Replace our existing Jenkins pipelines with equivalent GitHub Actions workflows for build and test.

tasks.title: Move build pipeline off Jenkins
tasks.body: We want to retire Jenkins and run our CI builds and tests using GitHub Actions instead.

tasks.title: Cache product catalog lookups in Redis
tasks.body: Frequent catalog reads hit the database directly. Add a Redis caching layer to reduce DB load.

tasks.title: Reduce database load from catalog queries
tasks.body: The product catalog is queried constantly and hammering Postgres. Introduce a Redis cache in front of these reads.

tasks.title: Paginate the /orders API endpoint
tasks.body: The orders endpoint returns all records at once, causing slow responses. Add limit/offset pagination.

tasks.title: Orders API times out on large accounts
tasks.body: Accounts with thousands of orders can't load because the endpoint returns everything in one response. Introduce pagination to fix this.

tasks.title: Add dark mode toggle to settings
tasks.body: Implement a user-facing toggle in the settings page that switches the app between light and dark themes.

tasks.title: Support dark theme selection for users
tasks.body: Let users choose a dark color scheme from their preferences. Should persist across sessions.

tasks.title: Password reset email not being sent
tasks.body: Users report that clicking 'Forgot Password' does not deliver the reset email. Investigate the mailer queue and fix delivery.

tasks.title: Forgot password flow broken — no email arrives
tasks.body: When a user requests a password reset, no message ever shows up in their inbox. We need to get reset emails working again.

tasks.title: Broken avatar images on profile page
tasks.body: User avatars show a broken image icon on the profile view. Likely a wrong URL path after the CDN change.

tasks.title: Profile pictures not loading
tasks.body: After the recent CDN migration, avatar images fail to render on user profiles. Fix the image URLs.

tasks.title: Export report data as CSV
tasks.body: Add a button on the reports screen that downloads the current report as a CSV file.

tasks.title: Allow downloading reports in CSV format
tasks.body: Users need to export their reports to a spreadsheet. Provide a CSV download option from the report view.

tasks.title: Rate limit the public search API
tasks.body: Add per-IP rate limiting to the search endpoint to prevent abuse and scraping.

tasks.title: Prevent search endpoint abuse with throttling
tasks.body: The public search API is being scraped heavily. Implement request throttling by IP address.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for currency conversion util
tasks.body: The convertCurrency helper has no test coverage. Write tests covering rounding and unsupported currencies.

tasks.title: Improve test coverage for money conversion helper
tasks.body: Our currency conversion function is untested. Add unit tests, including edge cases like rounding and invalid currency codes.

tasks.title: Add retry logic to payment webhook handler
tasks.body: When the Stripe webhook processor fails, retry with exponential backoff up to five times before dead-lettering the event.

tasks.title: Support Apple Pay in payment flow
tasks.body: Integrate Apple Pay as an additional payment method in the checkout, including button rendering and token handling.

tasks.title: Add CSV export to analytics dashboard
tasks.body: Let users download the currently filtered metrics table as a CSV file with proper column headers.

tasks.title: Add date range picker to analytics dashboard
tasks.body: Replace the fixed 7/30/90 day buttons with a custom date range selector that updates all charts on the dashboard.

tasks.title: Add dark mode toggle to settings page
tasks.body: Introduce a theme switcher in user preferences that persists the choice and applies a dark color palette across the app.

tasks.title: Increase font size options in settings
tasks.body: Add small/medium/large text size controls to the accessibility section of the settings page and apply them globally.

tasks.title: Add fuzzy matching to product search
tasks.body: Improve the search engine to tolerate typos and partial matches using trigram similarity. Users should find products even with minor spelling errors.

tasks.title: Implement infinite scroll on search results
tasks.body: Replace the numbered pagination on the search results page with infinite scroll that loads more items as the user reaches the bottom.

tasks.title: Encrypt user PII at rest in the database
tasks.body: Add column-level encryption for email, phone, and address fields in the users table. Keys should be managed via the KMS service.

tasks.title: Add password strength meter to signup form
tasks.body: Show a real-time strength indicator as the user types their password during registration, enforcing a minimum score before submission.

tasks.title: Optimize checkout cart total calculation
tasks.body: The cart totals endpoint recomputes taxes and discounts on every render. Cache intermediate results to reduce latency.

tasks.title: Add gift wrapping option at checkout
tasks.body: Allow customers to select gift wrapping and add a personalized message during the checkout flow, adding a small fee to the order.

tasks.title: Add rate limiting to the public API
tasks.body: Implement per-API-key rate limiting with a sliding window to protect the public REST endpoints from abuse.

tasks.title: Add pagination cursors to the public API
tasks.body: Replace offset-based pagination with cursor-based pagination on the list endpoints of the public API for stable results.

tasks.title: Migrate notifications service to Kafka
tasks.body: Move the notification event stream from RabbitMQ to Kafka to improve throughput and enable replay of missed events.

tasks.title: Add email digest for notifications
tasks.body: Allow users to batch non-urgent notifications into a daily email digest instead of receiving them individually.

tasks.title: Fix memory leak in video player component
tasks.body: The video player retains event listeners after unmount, causing memory to grow during long sessions. Clean up listeners on teardown.

tasks.title: Add playback speed control to video player
tasks.body: Introduce a speed selector (0.5x to 2x) in the video player controls that adjusts playback rate in real time.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for the invoice generator
tasks.body: Cover edge cases in the invoice generation module including proration, multi-currency, and zero-total invoices.

tasks.title: Support PDF export for invoices
tasks.body: Generate downloadable PDF versions of invoices with company branding and line-item breakdowns from the invoice module.

tasks.title: Send order confirmation emails via SendGrid
tasks.body: Integrate SendGrid to deliver transactional order confirmation emails. Include order summary and tracking link in the template.

tasks.title: Send order confirmation SMS via Twilio
tasks.body: Integrate Twilio to deliver order confirmation text messages with a shortened tracking URL. Support opt-out handling per region.

tasks.title: Integrate Stripe for subscription billing
tasks.body: Set up Stripe to handle recurring subscription charges, webhooks for renewals, and failed payment retries.

tasks.title: Integrate PayPal for one-time checkout
tasks.body: Set up PayPal Checkout for single-purchase orders, including capture flow and refund handling.

tasks.title: Export analytics dashboard to PDF
tasks.body: Allow users to export the current analytics dashboard view as a formatted PDF including charts and date range.

tasks.title: Export analytics dashboard to CSV
tasks.body: Allow users to export the underlying analytics dataset as a CSV file matching the selected filters and date range.

tasks.title: Add OAuth login for Google
tasks.body: Implement Google OAuth 2.0 flow on the login page so users can sign in with their Google accounts. Store tokens securely and map to existing user records.

tasks.title: Add OAuth login for Microsoft
tasks.body: Implement Microsoft Entra ID OAuth flow on the login page so users can sign in with their Microsoft accounts. Handle tenant configuration and token refresh.

tasks.title: Add caching layer using Redis for product catalog
tasks.body: Introduce Redis to cache product catalog reads and reduce database load on the storefront listing pages.

tasks.title: Add caching layer using Memcached for session data
tasks.body: Introduce Memcached to store ephemeral user session data and reduce read pressure on the primary datastore.

tasks.title: Add file upload support to AWS S3
tasks.body: Wire up the media upload service to store user attachments in an S3 bucket with signed URLs for retrieval.

tasks.title: Add file upload support to Google Cloud Storage
tasks.body: Wire up the media upload service to store user attachments in a GCS bucket with signed URLs and lifecycle rules for cleanup.

tasks.title: Add dark mode to the mobile app
tasks.body: Implement a dark theme for the iOS and Android mobile app that respects the system appearance setting.

tasks.title: Add dark mode to the web dashboard
tasks.body: Implement a dark theme toggle for the web dashboard, persisting the user's preference across sessions.

tasks.title: Add push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging
tasks.body: Integrate FCM to send push notifications to Android devices for chat message alerts.

tasks.title: Add push notifications via APNs
tasks.body: Integrate Apple Push Notification service to send push notifications to iOS devices for chat message alerts.

tasks.title: Ship logs to Datadog
tasks.body: Configure the log forwarder to ship application logs to Datadog with proper service tagging and log levels.

tasks.title: Ship logs to Splunk
tasks.body: Configure the log forwarder to ship application logs to Splunk HEC with indexing by environment and source.

tasks.title: Sync contacts to Salesforce CRM
tasks.body: Build a nightly job that pushes new and updated contact records into Salesforce, mapping our fields to their lead objects.

tasks.title: Sync contacts to HubSpot CRM
tasks.body: Build a nightly job that pushes new and updated contact records into HubSpot, mapping our fields to their contact properties.

tasks.title: Fix crash when uploading HEIC images on iOS
tasks.body: The app crashes when a user selects a HEIC photo from their library. Add conversion handling before upload.

tasks.title: Implement rate limiting on public API endpoints
tasks.body: Add per-IP rate limiting to the public REST API to prevent abuse. Return 429 responses with retry-after headers.

tasks.title: Investigate memory leak in WebSocket service
tasks.body: Memory usage grows steadily on the chat WebSocket service until it OOMs after ~12 hours. Profile and fix the leak.

tasks.title: Add CSV export for monthly sales report
tasks.body: Finance needs to export the monthly sales report as CSV. Add a download button that generates the file with all line items.

tasks.title: Support keyboard shortcuts in the code editor
tasks.body: Add configurable keyboard shortcuts for common actions like save, format, and find in the in-app code editor.

tasks.title: Reduce Docker image size for the API service
tasks.body: The API Docker image is 1.2GB. Switch to a multi-stage build with an alpine base to shrink it significantly.

tasks.title: Add dark mode toggle to settings page
tasks.body: Users have requested a dark theme option. Implement a toggle in the settings panel that persists across sessions.

tasks.title: Optimize nightly database backup job
tasks.body: The nightly Postgres backup is taking over 4 hours. Investigate compression and incremental backup strategies to reduce runtime.

tasks.title: Add pagination to the customer orders list
tasks.body: The orders page loads all records at once and slows down for large accounts. Add server-side pagination with page size controls.

tasks.title: Redesign the mobile app splash screen
tasks.body: Update the splash screen with the new brand logo and animation per the latest design spec.

tasks.title: Update onboarding email copy for new pricing
tasks.body: Marketing has revised pricing tiers. Update the welcome email template to reflect the new plans and CTA links.

tasks.title: Migrate CI pipeline from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
tasks.body: Replace the legacy Jenkins jobs with GitHub Actions workflows for build, test, and deploy stages.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for the tax calculation module
tasks.body: The tax module has no coverage. Write unit tests covering edge cases like exemptions and multi-state rules.

tasks.title: Fix misaligned footer on the landing page
tasks.body: The footer columns are misaligned on tablet-width viewports. Adjust the CSS grid to render evenly.

tasks.title: Integrate Stripe webhook for subscription events
tasks.body: Handle Stripe webhooks for subscription.created and canceled events to keep our billing records in sync.

tasks.title: Improve accessibility of the search filter dropdown
tasks.body: The filter dropdown is not navigable via keyboard and lacks ARIA labels. Add proper focus management and screen reader support.

tasks.title: Cache geocoding results to reduce API costs
tasks.body: We call the maps geocoding API repeatedly for the same addresses. Add a Redis cache keyed by normalized address.

tasks.title: Add a confirmation modal before deleting a project
tasks.body: Users accidentally delete projects. Show a confirmation dialog requiring them to type the project name to confirm.

tasks.title: Localize the checkout flow into German and French
tasks.body: Add translations for all checkout screen strings and format currency and dates per locale.

tasks.title: Set up alerting for high CPU on production nodes
tasks.body: Configure Prometheus alerts to page on-call when CPU usage exceeds 85% for more than 5 minutes on any prod node.
